verdict.rationale: Rippling is a SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask, and a probe confirms an official Rippling MCP server documented on the first-party developer site at a dedicated overview page. The rest of the pack covers the REST API, bearer tokens and OAuth, which support agent access but say nothing more about the MCP server itself. Missing for 10: details on the MCP tools and scope exposed, setup/auth steps for connecting an agent, coverage of IT-specific objects, independent or hands-on corroboration.
